concern: (low) Relative preview image path (assets/images/knowledge-base-crie-hero.webp) requires a fallback placeholder in offline or standalone environments.
jtbd: When viewing the mockup in standalone or offline environments without static assets loaded, I want a resilient fallback placeholder for the preview image, so that visual layout stability and layout hierarchy are preserved without broken image artifacts.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the mockup is rendered in an offline environment where 'assets/images/knowledge-base-crie-hero.webp' fails to load, When the image onerror event triggers or when CSS fallback styles are evaluated, Then a styled SVG/CSS placeholder container with consistent aspect ratio is displayed without causing Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS < 0.1).
editInstruction: In section[aria-labelledby="media-heading"], update the img element for 'assets/images/knowledge-base-crie-hero.webp' to include an onerror handler or wrap it in a fallback container (e.g., onerror="this.onerror=null;this.src='data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 800 450' fill='%231e293b'><rect width='800' height='450' fill='%230f172a'/><text x='50%' y='50%' fill='%2364748b' dominant-baseline='middle' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='20'>Preview Unavailable</text></svg>';" class="w-full h-auto object-cover min-h-[180px] bg-slate-900") to provide immediate visual resilience.

concern: (low) Telemetry KPI card items should include explicit aria-describedby attributes for assistive accessibility parity.
jtbd: When navigating the operational telemetry KPI cards using screen readers or assistive devices, I want the metric values to programmatically reference their explanatory labels, so that I can understand the metric context unambiguously without visual spatial deduction.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a user navigates to the telemetry KPI cards in section[data-domain-module="telemetry-kpi"], When an assistive technology focuses or reads each metric value, Then each metric value has an aria-describedby attribute referencing the unique id of its corresponding label element.
editInstruction: In section[data-domain-module="telemetry-kpi"], assign unique id attributes to the metric label divs (e.g., id="kpi-label-full-product", id="kpi-label-design", id="kpi-label-refresh") and add matching aria-describedby attributes to the metric value divs (e.g., aria-describedby="kpi-label-full-product", aria-describedby="kpi-label-design", aria-describedby="kpi-label-refresh") to establish explicit assistive accessibility binding.
